title: Accounts
intro: Every account, newest first. One role each: players play, game masters write the content, superadmins manage the accounts.
suspendHint: It is signed out at once and can no longer sign in. Its games are kept.
created: Account created. Hand its password over yourself: no email is sent.

form.passwordHint: 8 to 32 characters. The account keeps it until it can change it (Phase 11).
